body:
A valid M4 tenant-a key could send a valid tenant-b chat and receive 200. This backport requires the authenticated key binding to match the unique, valid tenant header before data-plane admission. Unbound keys and missing authenticators fail closed in tenant mode, including DEV_NO_KEY library configurations.

Tenant audit attribution now comes from the authenticated response marker, preventing denial traffic from writing victim-tenant facts. Chat role/privacy scope enforcement precedes request.received. Missing tenant headers retain handler/body error precedence for authenticated callers; health remains available.

Validation:

- Valid-body, eligible-card baseline reproduces 200 versus required 403. Final matrix covers nine M4 endpoints, cross-tenant/unbound/anonymous/malformed keys and duplicate tenant headers, with no unauthorized egress/events/records.
- Tenant library missing-authenticator cases cover both dev settings, bearer presence and health. All 25 tenant-focused tests pass.
- Removing binding, trusted audit attribution or default-deny independently makes regressions fail by assertion; final code restored.
- Full feature-enabled serial Rust suite passes (router 438); fmt, strict all-target clippy, cargo deny and all six pnpm gates pass. Shared conformance: 134 passed / 8 todo.

294 changed lines across four files; base #484. Combined acceptance #486 now passes the complete gates (router 441) and rebuilt release Rust conformance 134/8, wire 1.0.1; its delta is test-only. Independent approvals and actual-main acceptance remain required; this does not authorize a release or tag.
title: fix(auth): enforce tenant key authority on M4 admission and audit
